disciplinary_grounds.description: Making any material misrepresentation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making any material misrepresentation.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making false promises likely to influence, persuade, or induce
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making any false promises of a character likely to influence, persuade or induce.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Accepting a commission as broker-salesperson or salesperson from anyone except the licensed broker or owner-developer
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Accepting a commission or valuable consideration as a real estate broker-salesperson or salesperson for the performance of any of the acts specified in this chapter or chapter 119 or 119A of NRS from any person except the licensed real estate broker with whom he or she is associated or the owner-developer by whom he or she is employed.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Representing or attempting to represent a broker other than the one with whom the licensee is associated without express knowledge and consent
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Representing or attempting to represent a real estate broker other than the broker with whom he or she is associated, without the express knowledge and consent of the broker with whom he or she is associated.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to maintain brokerage and property management agreements for review and audit by the Division
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to maintain, for review and audit by the Division, each brokerage agreement and property management agreement governed by the provisions of this chapter and entered into by the licensee.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing within a reasonable time to account for or remit money belonging to others
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing, within a reasonable time, to account for or to remit any money which comes into his or her possession and which belongs to others.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to balance the trust account at least monthly or to submit annual accounting to Division
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to balance the trust account at least monthly; and Failing to submit to the Division an annual accounting of the trust account as required in NRS 645.310.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Commingling money or property of clients with the licensee's own, or converting money of others to personal use
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Commingling the money or other property of his or her clients with his or her own or converting the money of others to his or her own use.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Broker-salesperson or salesperson failing to place deposits or funds in the custody of the licensed broker as soon as possible
disciplinary_grounds.quote: In the case of a broker-salesperson or salesperson, failing to place in the custody of his or her licensed broker or owner-developer, as soon as possible, any deposit or other money or consideration entrusted to him or her by any person dealing with him or her as the representative of his or her licensed broker.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Accepting other than cash as earnest money without communicating that fact to the owner before acceptance
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Accepting other than cash as earnest money unless that fact is communicated to the owner before his or her acceptance of the offer to purchase and that fact is shown in the receipt for the earnest money.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Broker failing to deposit earnest money check or cash before end of next banking day
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Upon acceptance of an agreement, in the case of a broker, failing to deposit any check or cash received as earnest money before the end of the next banking day unless otherwise provided in the purchase agreement.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Inducing any party to break a brokerage or sale agreement to substitute a new agreement for personal gain
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Inducing any party to a brokerage agreement, property management agreement, agreement of sale or lease to break it in order to substitute a new brokerage agreement, property management agreement, agreement of sale or lease with the same or another party if the inducement to make the substitution is offered to secure personal gain to the licensee or owner-developer.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining a license, permit, or registration by false or fraudulent representation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the licensee, property manager or owner-developer has, by false or fraudulent representation, obtained a license, permit or registration

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully using a trade name, service mark, or insigne of membership in a real estate organization without legal right
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully using any trade name, service mark or insigne of membership in any real estate organization of which the licensee is not a member, without the legal right to do so.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any order of the Commission, any agreement with the Division, or provisions of applicable chapters
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating any order of the Commission, any agreement with the Division, any of the provisions of this chapter, chapter 116, 119, 119A, 119B, 645A or 645C of NRS or any regulation adopted pursuant thereto.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Paying a commission or finder's fee to an unlicensed person for performing broker or salesperson services
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Paying a commission, compensation or a finder's fee to any person for performing the services of a broker, broker-salesperson or salesperson who has not secured a license pursuant to this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of or guilty plea to a felony related to practice, or any crime involving fraud, deceit, misrepresentation or moral turpitude
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A conviction of, or the entry of a plea of guilty, guilty but mentally ill or nolo contendere to: (1) A felony relating to the practice of the licensee, property manager or owner-developer; or (2) Any crime involving fraud, deceit, misrepresentation or moral turpitude.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Guaranteeing or permitting guarantees of future profits from resale of real property
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Guaranteeing, or having authorized or permitted any person to guarantee, future profits which may result from the resale of real property.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to include a fixed date of expiration in any written brokerage agreement or failing to leave a copy with the client
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to include a fixed date of expiration in any written brokerage agreement or failure to leave a copy of such a brokerage agreement or any property management agreement with the client.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Accepting, giving, or charging any undisclosed commission, rebate, or direct profit on expenditures for a client
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Accepting, giving or charging any undisclosed commission, rebate or direct profit on expenditures made for a client.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Gross negligence or incompetence in performing any act requiring a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Gross negligence or incompetence in performing any act for which the person is required to hold a license pursuant to this chapter, chapter 119, 119A or 119B of NRS.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any other conduct constituting deceitful, fraudulent, or dishonest dealing
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any other conduct which constitutes deceitful, fraudulent or dishonest dealing.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conduct before licensure that was unknown to the Division and would have been grounds for denial
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any conduct which took place before the person became licensed which was in fact unknown to the Division and which would have been grounds for denial of a license had the Division been aware of the conduct.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly permitting any person whose license has been revoked or suspended to act as a real estate broker, broker-salesperson, or salesperson
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly permitting any person whose license has been revoked or suspended to act as a real estate broker, broker-salesperson or salesperson, with or on behalf of the licensee.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Suspension or revocation of a real estate license issued by any other jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The Commission may take action pursuant to NRS 645.630 against a person who is subject to that section for the suspension or revocation of a real estate broker's, broker-salesperson's or salesperson's license issued by any other jurisdiction.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Offering real estate for sale or lease without knowledge and consent of the owner or on unauthorized terms
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Offering real estate for sale or lease without the knowledge and consent of the owner or the owner's authorized agent or on terms other than those authorized by the owner or the owner's authorized agent.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Negotiating directly with a client who has an exclusive brokerage agreement with another broker without written permission
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Negotiating a sale, exchange or lease of real estate, or communicating after such negotiations but before closing, directly with a client if the person knows that the client has a brokerage agreement in force in connection with the property granting an exclusive agency

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to deliver a completed copy of any purchase agreement or offer to buy or sell within a reasonable time
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to deliver within a reasonable time a completed copy of any purchase agreement or offer to buy or sell real estate to the purchaser or to the seller

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to deliver complete closing statement to seller within 10 business days after closing, or to buyer
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to deliver to the seller in each real estate transaction, within 10 business days after the transaction is closed, a complete, detailed closing statement showing all of the receipts and disbursements handled by him or her for the seller

disciplinary_grounds.description: Representing to any lender or guaranteeing agency an amount in excess of actual sale price or differing terms
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Representing to any lender, guaranteeing agency or any other interested party, verbally or through the preparation of false documents, an amount in excess of the actual sale price of the real estate or terms differing from those actually agreed upon.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to produce any document, book, or record in possession or control concerning a real estate transaction under investigation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to produce any document, book or record in his or her possession or under his or her control, concerning any real estate transaction under investigation by the Division.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to reduce a bona fide offer to writing when a proposed purchaser requests it
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to reduce a bona fide offer to writing where a proposed purchaser requests that it be submitted in writing

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to submit all written bona fide offers to a seller until seller accepts an offer in writing
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to submit all written bona fide offers to a seller when the offers are received before the seller accepts an offer in writing and until the broker has knowledge of that acceptance

disciplinary_grounds.description: Refusing because of race, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or ethnic group to show, sell, or rent real estate to qualified purchasers or renters
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Refusing because of race, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or ethnic group to show, sell or rent any real estate for sale or rent to qualified purchasers or renters.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly submitting any false or fraudulent appraisal to any financial institution or other interested person
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly submitting any false or fraudulent appraisal to any financial institution or other interested person.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to pay money owed to the Commission or Division
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Refuse to renew, or suspend or revoke, the license, permit, certificate or registration of a person who has failed to pay money which the person owes to the Commission or the Division.

establishment_regulation_required.quote: Every real estate broker shall have and maintain a definite place of business within the State, which must be a room or rooms used for the transaction of real estate business

definition_quote.value: "Real estate broker" means a person who, for another and for compensation or with the intention or expectation of receiving compensation: (a) Sells, exchanges, options, purchases, rents or leases, or negotiates or offers, attempts or agrees to negotiate the sale, exchange, option, purchase, rental or lease of, or lists or solicits prospective purchasers, lessees or renters of, any real estate or the improvements thereon or any modular homes, used manufactured homes, used mobile homes or other housing offered or conveyed with any interest in real estate; (b) Engages in or offers to engage in the business of claiming, demanding, charging, receiving, collecting or contracting for the collection of an advance fee in connection with any employment undertaken to promote the sale or lease of business opportunities or real estate by advance fee listing advertising or other offerings to sell, lease, exchange or rent property; (c) Engages in or offers to engage in the business of property management; or (d) Engages in or offers to engage in the business of business brokerage.
definition_quote.quote: "Real estate broker" means a person who, for another and for compensation or with the intention or expectation of receiving compensation: (a) Sells, exchanges, options, purchases, rents or leases, or negotiates or offers, attempts or agrees to negotiate the sale, exchange, option, purchase, rental or lease of, or lists or solicits prospective purchasers, lessees or renters of, any real estate or the improvements thereon or any modular homes, used manufactured homes, used mobile homes or other housing offered or conveyed with any interest in real estate

pre_exam_instruction_hours.quote: an applicant for an original real estate salesperson's license must furnish proof satisfactory to the Real Estate Division that the applicant has successfully completed a course of instruction which consists of not less than 120 hours of instruction in the principles, practices, procedures, law and ethics of real estate

license_revocation_reapplication_waiting.quote: After the revocation of any license, permit or registration by the Commission as provided in this chapter, no new license, permit or registration may be issued to the same licensee, permittee or registrant, as appropriate, within 1 year after the date of the revocation

written_service_agreement_required.quote: Every brokerage agreement which includes a provision for an exclusive agency representation must: 1. Be in writing.

(b) Each source from which the licensee will receive compensation as a result of the transaction. (c) That the licensee is a principal to the transaction or has an interest in a principal to the transaction.

listing_contract_termination_date_requir.quote: Failure to include a fixed date of expiration in any written brokerage agreement or failure to leave a copy of such a brokerage agreement or any property management agreement with the client.

escrow_account_required.quote: If a real estate broker receives money, as a broker, which belongs to others, the real estate broker shall promptly deposit the money in a separate checking account located in a bank or credit union in this State which must be designated a trust account.

commingling_of_funds_prohibited.quote: A real estate broker shall not commingle the money or other property of a client with his or her own.

fixed_office_required.quote: Every real estate broker shall have and maintain a definite place of business within the State, which must be a room or rooms used for the transaction of real estate business

salesperson_broker_affiliation_required.quote: No real estate broker-salesperson or salesperson may be associated with or employed by more than one broker or owner-developer at the same time.

qualified_association_permitted.quote: Any natural person who meets the qualifications of a real estate broker-salesperson or salesperson and is the sole shareholder of a corporation organized pursuant to the provisions of chapter 89 of NRS may be licensed on behalf of the corporation or limited-liability company for the purpose of associating with a licensed real estate broker in the capacity of a broker-salesperson or salesperson.

recovery_fund_exists.quote: The Real Estate Education, Research and Recovery Fund is hereby created as a special revenue fund.

recovery_fund_max_per_claim.quote: that person, upon termination of all proceedings, including appeals in connection with any judgment, may file a verified petition in the court in which the judgment was entered for an order directing payment out of the Fund in the amount of the unpaid actual damages included in the judgment, but not more than $25,000 per judgment.

recovery_fund_max_per_licensee.quote: The liability of the Fund does not exceed $100,000 for any person licensed pursuant to this chapter, whether the person is licensed as a limited-liability company, partnership, association or corporation or as a natural person, or both.

broker_price_opinion_permitted.quote: A person licensed pursuant to this chapter may prepare and provide a broker's price opinion and charge and collect a fee therefor if: (a) The license of that licensee is active and in good standing

license_exemptions.quote: The provisions of this chapter do not apply to, and the terms "real estate broker" and "real estate salesperson" do not include, any: (a) Owner or lessor of property, or any regular employee of such a person, who performs any of the acts mentioned in NRS 645.030, 645.040, 645.230 and 645.260, with respect to the property in the regular course of or as an incident to the management of or investment in the property.
